title: Queue deadlock: a GPU job cannot bypass a GPU-blocked head while a benchmark waits
body: Observed 2026-10-13 21:00-22:30 on ws: the queue line's head was a shared GPU job blocked=gpu because an exclusive benchmark job (rjs2 parity-midday-928, a cmd.exe native capture) was waiting; the benchmark was blocked=ready but _flow_head_bypass_ok returns 1 for any GPU job behind a head whose reason is gpu, so neither could run and the device sat idle for 60+ minutes (shared-holders=0/2, exclusive-holders=0, benchmark-waiting=1). Lane capperf1 broke it once by withdrawing its own head job; it recurred with rjs2's own split-gpu as head. Fix: when the head is gpu-blocked only because a benchmark waits, let the waiting benchmark pass it (or do not count a waiting benchmark as a blocker for the head once the head itself is a shared GPU job older than the benchmark).

title: Queue benchmark heuristic matches lane names containing perf/native/timing
body: with-test-lock.sh promotes a --resource gpu job to an exclusive benchmark when its --label matches (bench|native|timing|perf|pacing|calibrat). The lane convention is --label <lane>:<step>, so a lane named capperf1 (or any lane with perf/native/timing in its name) makes every GPU job exclusive and blocks other lanes' shared jobs. Lane capperf1 used the label prefix cp1 to avoid it. Fix: match the step part only, or require --gpu-benchmark for exclusivity and keep the heuristic as a warning.

title: Reconfigure rewrites generated SDI headers and recompiles their dependents
body: A CMake re-run on build/wsl (triggered by a test-registration edit) rewrote build/wsl/generated/CapabilityGraphBuildConfig.h and application/main/generated/sdi/*-SDI.g.h / *Names.g.h with unchanged content, which recompiled 7 objects (GPUTimestampQuery, CapabilityGraph, SwapChainNode, ProxyRasterStageNode, DeviceNode, BodyOctreeSceneNode, BuildRenderGraph) and relinked libVixenApp.a and vixen_planet_capture while capture processes were running from the old binary. Cause INFERRED: configure-time generation writes the files unconditionally (mtime bump) instead of configure_file/file(GENERATE)-style write-if-different. A write-if-different step would make reconfigures no-ops for unchanged generated headers.
